scheme_name_english: Madhya Pradesh Natural Farming Development Scheme
department: Kisan Kalyan and Agriculture Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Promotes chemical-free farming, better soil health and environmental protection. The scheme includes support such as training and financial assistance according to applicable guidelines.
eligibility: Farmers of all categories who are interested in practising natural farming on their own agricultural land.
application_process: Contact the Agriculture Department at the district or block level for the current registration or implementation process.
source_type: MP Government CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
